summary.headline: Florentine Astrological Codices
summary.text: Catalogue of Florentine astrological manuscripts begins with Laurentianus Plut. 28, cod. 7, describing works by Theon, Ptolemy, Proclus, Geminus, Paulus Alexandrinus, and Rhetorius, followed by Roman and Arab month lists. It then records Plut. 28, cod. 17, a Persian astronomical syntaxis or zij attributed to Sampsouchares, and introduces cod. 20.
